title: 염업조합법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters delegated by the Salt Industry Cooperative Act and the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and matters necessary for their enforcement.

correction.after:
